starting_trace: Published 85% compensated trace; not an independent 100% measurement
method: Rapp100 = Rapp85 - (1-f)/f * DeltaR_gap; same current grid and free-intercept Tafel+jR model
assumption: Same constant compensation resistance, same electrode area and conditions; linear voltage subtraction
interpretation: Remaining apparent fit coefficient, not a measured residual solution resistance or a uniquely kinetic resistance
